message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Basic Version)** | Section | Details | |---------|---------| | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in a hand and then scoring the sum of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On a player’s turn they may:
1. **Play a card** from their hand that matches either the color or the value of the top discard card, or play a Wild card.
2. **Draw a card** from the draw pile if they cannot or choose not to play. If the drawn card can be played immediately, they may do so; otherwise, the turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if the player has no matching color cards; otherwise, the player may be challenged.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by opponents: numbered cards count as their face value, action cards count as 20 points, Wild cards count as 50 points. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s cumulative total. If the winner reaches or exceeds the target score (usually 500), the game ends and that player is the overall winner. | | **Special Rules** | • **Uno Call** – When a player has one card left, they must say “UNO!” before the next player takes a turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: the player must draw two cards.
• **Challenge** – If a player believes a “Wild Draw Four” was played illegally, they can challenge. If the challenger is correct, the original player draws four cards; if incorrect, the challenger draws six cards. | | **Variations** | Many house rules exist (e.g., “Stacking” where Draw Twos can be stacked, “No Challenge” rule, “Custom Decks”). Always agree on variations before starting. | **Quick Play Summary** 1. Shuffle & deal 7 cards each. 2. Flip top card to start discard pile. 3. Clockwise turns: play matching card or draw. 4. Use action cards to affect opponents. 5. Say “UNO!” when you have one card. 6. First to 500 points wins. Enjoy your game!
